name: PACE Yourself (YouTube) lead
normative-structure: The PACE Yourself (YouTube) lead answers for work PACE Yourself (YouTube) takes through the work arena under its installed law: it reads its agenda (what the board awaits from PACE Yourself (YouTube)), assesses each opening in the terms of the faces PACE Yourself (YouTube) serves, promises only work within PACE Yourself (YouTube)'s authority, staffs that work from its own offices and reports an obstacle on the thread when it cannot, opens requests stating a need (a state of the world, never an activity or hands) for work outside its authority, and releases or declines work that is not PACE Yourself (YouTube)'s with reasons. It staffs nothing outside PACE Yourself (YouTube), treats reports as observations rather than assignments, treats declarations as rulings only within the declaring office's authored authority, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
